title: Copper Wire
body: A copper wire has a density of rho=$$8920\,\tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}}**3$$, a radius of $$1.20\, \text{mm}$$, $$and$$ $$a$$ $$length$$ $$L$$. $$The$$ $$wire$$ $$is$$ $$held$$ $$under$$ $$a$$ $$tension$$ $$of$$ $$10.00\, \text{N}$$. $$Transverse$$ $$waves$$ $$are$$ $$sent$$ $$down$$ $$the$$ $$wire$$.
